All day, everyday El Cafe
Feb 2023 • Friends
Wooow! This place is amazing! As a vegetarian it is so hard to find good restaurants in Asia.. So once I found this place I came there everyday. One day I even did breakfast lunch and dinner! The food is incredible, from Indian to pizzas and salads to desserts. They have it all and it tastes to damn good! The staff is super friendly aswell. 

This once guy, I keep on forgetting his name (sorry my friend) truly deserves an award for his hospitality! He reminds your orders so your drinks are ready once your reach your table. Also he know the menu so well that he gives suggestions on your fast to explore more of the menu. 

Unforgettable I can only give a 5 star rating.. they absolutely deserve a 10/10! Oh and also, the wifi is supper good!! Make sure you visit! And leave a review!

Great multi cuisine vegetarian restaurant in Mui Ne.
Aug 2022 • Couples
My wife and I were travelling to Mui ne from Ho chi Minh for a day, difficult to find restaurants serving only vegetarian food, we stumbled upon El cafe on google and were glad we did. 

We visited El cafe twice and were left with a feeling of satisfaction in terms of service and food. The first visit we went with Indian food, this is probably be the best Indian food in Mui ne. Being experimental on our second visit, we tried Mexican tacos which were delicious! The owner/manager were very friendly and took our recommendation of adding more spice to our food. 

Will definitely recommend El cafe to anyone looking for delicious vegetarian food in Mui Ne.
